create_config_glm_ocr: create a GlmOcrConfig instance with vision and text sub-configs for GLM-OCR model initialization
build_vision_config: build a GlmOcrVisionConfig with depth, hidden_size, patch_size, and spatial_merge_size parameters for the vision encoder
build_text_config: build a GlmOcrTextConfig with vocab_size, num_hidden_layers, num_attention_heads, and max_position_embeddings for the text decoder
initialize_glm_ocr_model: initialize a GlmOcrForConditionalGeneration model using GlmOcrConfig with vision and text sub-configs
configure_ocr_token_ids: configure GLM-OCR image and video token IDs including start, end, and placeholder token identifiers
